---
title: "Lesson template"
---

Starter files for a single lesson inside a course. Copy this directory to
`courses/<course>/part-<n>/<NN>-<slug>/` and rename placeholders.

## Files

- `index.qmd` — lesson landing page and concepts
- `exercise.qmd` — small, focused practice task
- `lab.qmd` — pointer to a shared, reusable lab
- `quiz.qmd` — short knowledge check
- `summary.qmd` — recap and further reading
- `metadata.yaml` — machine-readable lesson descriptor

## Conventions

Lesson directories use a two-digit ordering prefix (`01-`, `02-`, ...) so the
filesystem order matches the intended reading order.

## OELS authoring

Lessons and their embedded exercises (`exercise.qmd`) copied from this
template inherit the shared Open Engineering Language Server (OELS)
authoring contract. Lesson prose in `.qmd` files (including YAML front
matter) is owned by Quarto and is not scanned by OELS. Lesson
`metadata.yaml` is silently ignored by OELS today — no
`apiVersion`/`kind` header should be added ad hoc. See the **OELS
authoring integration** section of
[`templates/README.qmd`](../README.qmd) for the full artifact
classification table, portable local stdio/LSP usage, how OELS
diagnostics differ from Quarto render errors, and troubleshooting.
